description: The plot illustrates how PPL varies with different context lengths for three settings of γ. The x-axis is labeled with context sizes shown as 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K on a linear categorical scale (evenly spaced tick positions), spanning from 2K to 64K. The y-axis is labeled “PPL” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 7.7 to 8.2 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.1 intervals. Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: the blue line (γ=0.25) starts near 8.19 at 2K, drops to about 7.83 at 4K, rises slightly to about 7.84 at 8K, then decreases to about 7.78 at 16K, increases slightly to about 7.79 at 32K, and ends around 7.78 at 64K. The orange line (γ=0.5) starts near 8.20 at 2K, drops to about 7.84 at 4K, decreases to about 7.74 at 8K, stays around 7.74 at 16K, decreases to about 7.73 at 32K, and remains about 7.73 at 64K. The green line (γ=0.75) starts near 8.20 at 2K, drops to about 7.84 at 4K, decreases to about 7.75 at 8K, decreases to about 7.73 at 16K, decreases to about 7.72 at 32K, and remains about 7.72 at 64K.
